description: Target-invariant four-way event grouping for the exploratory FLAN-T5-XL W17-Lite K-16 construction.

event_family.firm_operating_financial: The primary event concerns company earnings, guidance, products, technology, customers, demand, contracts, supply chains, production, capacity, manufacturing, or inventory.
event_family.policy_corporate: The primary event concerns regulation, trade policy, litigation, governance, operations, an analyst action, or a corporate action such as financing, restructuring, management change, or M&A.
event_family.macro_market: The primary event is a macroeconomic, monetary-policy, cross-sector, or broad-market development.
event_family.other_or_unclear: No listed group is supported by the supplied text, or the primary event group is unclear.
